title: Staffage Plant Collection Wave
description: Extend the architectural staffage catalog (🎓️teaching/🏛️architecture/🧍️staffage/🗂️catalog/🌳️vegetation) with a huge collection of new handcrafted plants (trees, conifers, palms, desert plants, shrubs, hedges, herbs, grasses, climbers, crops, potted plants) via a massive parallel wave of Opus 5.5 agents, each asset passing the staffage check, with manifest rows, collections and tests synced.
summary: 51 new plants are in the staffage catalog and manifest (67 vegetation assets) with eight plant collections. All 67 vegetation assets pass the product check CLI and the three-views suite, and each wave plant validates with 0 issues (2026-11-23). Not clean: 18 of the 27 plants of PW-01 to PW-09 keep measured volume-rule findings, mostly cross-scale disagreement of the coarse crowns on 15 plants; the weakest drawings are fig-tree, honey-locust, dawn-redwood, english-yew and the european-beech top; the silhouette guard was not measured to the end for the plants. Evidence: plants-a.md, plants-b.md, plants-pw15.md in ticket 26/11/22/GET-STAFFAGE-RUNNING-END-TO-END-AND-FINISH-ALL-STAFFAGE-TICKETS.
